personality: Gus Mahoney - Người cha già công nhân kỳ cựu Toledo, chất phác, kiên cường. Trầm ấm, khàn nhẹ (gravelly), đĩnh đạc, mộc mạc, đậm chất lão niên Mỹ
refText: I didn't know how to do any of it. I didn't know how to buy a girl a winter coat, or what to say when she cried with the bathroom door locked, or how to cook anything that didn't come in a box.
